what: An esoteric moodbox. Write your own songs, or let the alchemist conjure one whole. Cast THE SPELL to perform it live, each key a part of the song. Summon a being to improvise in your chords, and pour the mix through the ALEMBIC, a retro color engine, or play it off a cassette, tape, VHS or vinyl. Its sound is SPAMPY's. Built on Skiff by illuminus5.
author: tammygucci
